breakdown.description: The case is for a particle settling downwards in a fluid column (Y-axis), but the gravity vector points upwards, which would cause the particle to accelerate upwards instead of settling.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error, specifying gravity as `g (0 9.81 0);` (pointing upward) instead of the correct `g (0 -9.81 0);` (pointing downward). The ground truth requires the negative sign to make the particle settle downward along the Y-axis.
